In 2022, how did notices, proposed rules and final rules compare in number?
SELECT doc_type, count(*) AS documents FROM govblock_regulations.federal_register_documents WHERE issue_date LIKE '"2022-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the Democratic presidential vote in Westchester County change from 2016 to 2024?

SELECT year, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'NEW YORK' AND county_name = 'WESTCHESTER' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND party_simplified = 'DEMOCRAT' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which government agencies have the most forms in the collection?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS forms FROM govblock_reference.forms GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many robocall complaints did people in Florida file with the FCC in 2021?
SELECT count(*) AS complaints FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_consumer_complaints WHERE state = 'FL' AND issue LIKE '%Robocall%' AND date_created LIKE '%/2021'
How did New York City's unemployment rate change from April 2020 to December 2024?

SELECT year, period, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_la_data WHERE series_id = 'LAUCT365100000000003' AND ((cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' AND period = 'M04') OR (cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' AND period = 'M12')) ORDER BY year
Which molecular formulas are shared by the most PubChem compounds?
SELECT c1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much electricity came from hydroelectric dams in 2023?
SELECT try_cast(value AS double) AS thousand_mwh FROM govblock_energy.eia_elec_data WHERE series_id = 'ELEC.GEN.HYC-US-99.A' AND period = '2023'
Which states have had the most water discharge permit inspections?
SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS inspections FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_inspections GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Where did New York's electricity come from in 2023, fuel by fuel?

SELECT fuel_category, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(gen_mw AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_fuel_mix_rtfuelmix WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which cities are home to the most federal political committees?
SELECT cmte_city, cmte_st, count(DISTINCT cmte_id) AS committees FROM govblock_fec.committees GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many businesses registered in SAM.gov list a physical address in Montana?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_province_or_state = 'MT'
Which companies operate the most natural gas pipeline segments?
SELECT replace(operator, '"', ''), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_siting.hifld_natural_gas_pipelines WHERE replace(operator, '"', '') IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of single audit findings repeat a finding from an earlier year?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN upper(substr(cast(is_repeat_finding AS varchar), 1, 1)) = 'Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_executive.fac_findings
Which vendors were paid the most by federal campaigns in 2024?
SELECT name, sum(try_cast(transaction_amt AS double)) AS paid FROM govblock_fec.operating_expenditures WHERE cast(rpt_yr AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many molecules are in the 50-million sample of GDB-17?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.gdb_gdb17_50000000
Which recalls covered the most vehicles?
SELECT max(mfgname) AS manufacturer, campno, max(compname) AS component, max(try_cast(potaff AS bigint)) AS vehicles FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls GROUP BY campno ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 10
How did Maricopa County, Arizona split between the presidential candidates in 2024?

SELECT candidate, sum(try_cast(votes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_precinct_returns WHERE state = 'ARIZONA' AND county_name = 'MARICOPA' AND office = 'US PRESIDENT' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2024' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 6
Which U.S. patents have been cited most often by later patents?

SELECT p.patent_title, c.citation_patent_id, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_us_patent_citation c JOIN govblock_patents.pv_g_patent p ON p.patent_id = c.citation_patent_id GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recall campaigns involved Toyota vehicles in 2010?
SELECT count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls WHERE maketxt = 'TOYOTA' AND substr(cast(rcdate AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2010'
Which countries issued the most drug warnings recorded in ChEMBL?
SELECT warning_country, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_warning WHERE warning_country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
